leadHtml:
INPUT V0.27.0 COMPLETE

@fzlt/core/input

One controller for keys, pointer and a touch stick, mapped to named intents. Listeners only record; the engine's read phase latches edges and measures the target, so a step sees a stable snapshot. Keys typed into the host page's fields (or inside [data-fizlet-ignore]) never count. Keys, the pointer, press() and steer() wake a settled engine. Held state is dropped on window blur, when the engine pauses, on dispose() and on destroy: nothing stays stuck. hit (an intent or the pointer): a press is seen by exactly one fixed step, the first step after it, even when that comes frames later (0-step frames while catching up) and never again in the same frame's later steps. Outside a step (read, render), hit is true for the one frame whose read latched it. Presses between two steps count once.

API

ControlsOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for controls(): the intents and their keys, the pointer target and the touch stick.

export interface ControlsOptions {
    /** intent → key codes, e.g. { fire: ["Space"], up: ["KeyW", "ArrowUp"] } (KeyboardEvent.code). */
    keys?: Record<string, string[]>;
    /** Where the pointer is measured and the stick lives (default: the engine root, else window). */
    target?: HTMLElement;
    /** Touch: a drag that starts on the left half (or anywhere: "any") drives a virtual stick. */
    stick?: "left" | "any" | false;
    /** Stick radius in CSS px (default 60). */
    radius?: number;
}

Intent type COMPLETE

An intent by name, or by the number id(name) gave.

export type Intent = string | number;

controls function COMPLETE

One controller for keys, pointer and a touch stick on engine e, mapped to named intents: down(intent), hit(intent) (one step per press), pointer and stick. It registers its own read-phase system; dispose() removes it.

    /** Drive the stick from code (an on-screen stick, @fzlt/core/pad): x, y in -1..1; `on = false` lets go. */

Controls type COMPLETE

The controller controls() returns.

export type Controls = ReturnType<typeof controls>;

GamepadOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for gamepad(): which buttons press which intents, the dead zone, which pad.

export interface GamepadOptions {
    /** intent → standard-layout button indices, e.g. { fire: [0], jump: [1, 7] } (0 is A / cross). */
    map?: Record<string, number[]>;
    /** Dead zone, 0..1, for the left stick and analog buttons (default 0.15). */
    dead?: number;
    /** Read only the pad at this `navigator.getGamepads()` index (local multiplayer: a controller per
     *  seat); default: every pad, merged. */
    index?: number;
}

gamepad function COMPLETE

Gamepads into a controls() controller: mapped buttons press their intents (down from half a pull), the left stick steers the controller's stick, both past the dead zone. It polls in the controller's read phase, before the edges latch, and only while a pad is connected: a page without one never calls getGamepads() per frame. Pads have no events for buttons, so a settled engine is not polled: a pad connecting wakes it, and a game that settles between rounds wakes it from its own start key. Zero allocation per read. stop() removes it (listeners, polling, held intents and the stick).
